USURER-USURER.title: The Usurer
USURER-USURER.description:
An infernal syndicate banker who weaponizes real [gold]Gold[/gold] and compound interest.
[gold]Borrows[/gold] [gold]Gold[/gold] on credit ([gold]Debt[/gold]) for explosive tempo, binds enemies in [gold]Liens[/gold], and forces them to pay off the ledger.
USURER-USURER.goldMonologue: Gold is merely a promise written in someone else's blood.
USURER-USURER.eventDeathPrevention: My ledger is not yet balanced.
USURER-USURER.aromaPrinciple: Every soul has a price; the profit lies in the interest.
USURER-USURER.cardsModifierDescription: Usurer cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
